name: Asagi Ichiko wa Akujiki de Aru.
original_name: 浅葱一子は悪喰である。
source:
Furusawa Yuuka plays Kokkuri-san with three of her friends.
From that day on, her friends stop coming to school --
and she begins to hear footsteps creeping up behind her.
Amidst the growing unease, she encounters an upperclassman she has no memory of meeting before -- a mysterious figure with an uncanny presence.
“Shall I save you?” they ask.

Translated from [url=https://www.animategames.jp/home/detail/43956]Animate games[/url]
translation:
古泽优香和她的三个朋友一起扮演小栗桑。
从那天起，她的朋友们不再来学校了——
她开始听到身后有脚步声悄悄靠近。
在日益增长的不安中，她遇到了一位她以前不记得见过的学长——一个有着不可思议的存在的神秘人物。
“要我救你吗？”他们问。

翻译自 [url=https://www.animategames.jp/home/detail/43956]动画游戏[/url]
